title: P15.9-B0: full UI/UX redesign master plan — docs only
description: P15.9-B0 master plan docs + design-review R1 contract corrections (BASE 2232955, post-PR#91). docs/P15_9_B0/ holds README + A–H. R1 fixes: F1 /ui serves the SPA (not UI_HTML) when staticDir is set — UI_HTML only on bare-server runs; preservation/migration/rollback claims corrected to name the second-instance mode + port-as-precondition. F2 inbox honesty: targets_met_pending stays exact, list/HALT lane labeled partial over the <=200 returned summaries; HALT aggregation registered API_MISSING, never a fabricated badge count. F3 field/evidence mapping: /reviews per-row owner_action_required is historical; fresh pending = latest_review.owner_action_required + lifecycle.owner_action_pending; source_ceo_decision_id for binding provenance; CEO pass outcome separated from review outcome; budget aggregate vs ledger drill-down (API_MISSING). F4 scope boundaries: /api/businesses unfiltered (switcher seeds business_id manually then proves via /company), /api/approvals global queue labeled, /api/org-agents has no business query filter, vnext routes header-only actor vs legacy body.operator_id fallback; no multi-tenant claims. Docs-only: no code, no deps, no routes. Executable proof: cockpit + met-fold suites green.
